summary: New Cell.RetireWorldIntoPoolForSceneExit: the first half of a cell swap (a short suction, no rebuild) that parks a cell's world in EnvironmentPrismPool before its scene unloads. The swap's bookkeeping reset moved into ResetBooksAfterRetire (no behaviour change intended) and ReleaseRetiredWorld takes its slice as a parameter. Used only by the Maelstrom hub so a round re-issues the previewed arena instead of cloning it again. Also shared with the swap: the suction loop moved into SuctionRetiringWorld (no behaviour change intended), ReleaseRetiredWorld now drains NEWEST FIRST (detaching from the front of one container shifts every later sibling, the B36 pattern), and RetireWorldIntoSuctionRoot gained an optional flag (off for the swap) that leaves spawned NetworkObject lifeforms unparented.
why: A Maelstrom round laid its arena twice (hub preview, then the round), each a long frame with Relay live; a host freeze there ends the tournament (B45, Docs/Reports/MAELSTROM_MULTIPLAYER_RUNS.md).
